nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Every Botvy workflow names this one as its error workflow. Import it first so the reference resolves.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: $json.workflow?.name || 'unknown', error: ($json.execution?.error?.message || 'no detail') + ' @ ' + ($json.execution?.lastNodeExecuted || 'unknown node'), executionId: String($json.execution?.id || '') }) }}

nodes.name: Alert The Administrators
nodes.notes: The API resolves which devices belong to an administrator (Identity's DevicesQuery) and pushes to them; n8n holds only the service token.
